_meanings:
.²1 A kind of mystical mark (卐) on persons or things denoting good luck.
.²2 A lucky object.
.²3 The meeting of four roads.
.²4 The crossing of the arms, making a sign like the cross; {#stanavinihitahastasvastikABirvaDUBiH#}
 <ls>Māl. 4. 10</ls>; <ls>Śi. 10. 43</ls>.
.²5 A palace of particular form.
.²6 A particular symbol made with ground rice and shaped like a triangle.
.²7 A kind of cake.
.²8 A voluptuary, libertine.
.²9 Garlic.
.²10 A kind of bard (who utters words of eulogy); {#puraHsarEH svastikasUtamAgaDEH#}
 <ls>Rām. 2. 16. 46</ls> (<ab>com.</ab> {#svastikA jayajayeti vAdino vandinaH#}).

.²1 A mansion or temple of a particular form with a terrace in front.
.²2 A particular mode of sitting practised by {%Yogins%} (in which
 the toes are placed in the inner hollow of the knees).
.²3 A seat ({#pIWa#}) prepared for a deity; <ls>Mb. 12. 40. 7</ls> (<ab>com.</ab> {#svastikAn#}
 {#sarvatoBadrAdyaNkitAni devatApIWAni#}).
marked on the ear with the figure {#svastika#}.
